name: Boynton Beach 55th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting and Parade
address: 120 E Ocean Ave, Boynton Beach, FL 33435
paras: The City of Boynton Beach holds its 55th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 4 to 10 PM at Centennial Park & Amphitheater, 120 E Ocean Ave in downtown Boynton Beach. Admission is free.
For the first time, the city has folded its Holiday Parade performances and the tree lighting into a single celebration with a wonderland theme.

The evening includes a Kids Zone sponsored by Baptist Health South Florida, children's performances, favorite holiday characters, food vendors, festive photo spots and a drone show, all building toward the lighting of the city's holiday tree.
tip: Plan to arrive in the afternoon so the kids can use the Kids Zone before the drone show and tree lighting.

name: Holiday Boat Parade Watch Party at Boynton Harbor Marina
address: 735 Casa Loma Blvd, Boynton Beach, FL 33435
paras: The annual Holiday Boat Parade lights up the Intracoastal Waterway on Friday, December 11, 2026, and Boynton Harbor Marina, 735 Casa Loma Blvd, is the city's official Boynton Beach watch location from 6 to 9 PM.

The city hosts the parade with the Town of Lantana, the Town of Hypoluxo and the City of Delray Beach. Decorated boats travel south along the Intracoastal Waterway, and the marina watch party has holiday music, activities, food and a visit from Santa.
Boat captains can register to take part through December 4 by donating one new, unwrapped toy for Marine Toys for Tots. Spectators are encouraged to bring a new, unwrapped toy too.
tip: Bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Marine Toys for Tots collection and arrive before the boats pass.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Intracoastal Park in Boynton Beach
paras: Boynton Beach Recreation and Parks hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM at Intracoastal Park, 138 Harbors Way. The city calendar lists the cost as $18 for residents and $23 for nonresidents.
Santa and his Signing Elf come to town for a morning where little ones can take pictures with Santa, share their wish lists and make a holiday craft to take home.
Registration is handled through the Register link on the city's calendar listing. The listing marks the event as ADA accessible.
tip: Register through the city calendar link before you go and bring a camera for the Santa photos.
